headline: Nigeria: Guinea Insurance boosts its capital base to $4.2 million and maintains profitability in 2025
summary: Guinea Insurance Plc said at its 68th AGM on November 20, 2026 that its shareholders approved 2025 audited accounts showing revenue growth and sustained profitability.
why: Nigerian insurers must meet recapitalisation requirements, so capital strength and profitability shape their investment appeal.
original_headline: Nigeria : Guinea Insurance renforce ses fonds propres à 4,2 millions de dollars et maintient sa rentabilité en 2025
